channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: WorldOracle Tests Whether World Models Can Reliably Predict Real-World Executions
item.description: WorldOracle tests whether action-conditioned world models predict what robots actually do, revealing gaps in object motion and long-horizon accuracy.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla’s Lars Moravy Floats Optimus as a Cybercab Charging Helper
item.description: In a Munro Live discussion, Moravy suggests Optimus could help Cybercab use existing charging infrastructure, without announcing a firm deployment timetable.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Taps Korean Suppliers for Atlas, With 10,000-Robot Preparations Reported
item.description: KED Global reports a Hyundai Mobis-led component lineup and preparations for 10,000 Atlas robots. Final order quantities and prices remain undecided.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Employee Petition Against ICE Robot Deal Tests Its Ethical Guardrails
item.description: The company is standing by a deal for four modified Spot robots despite employee objections, highlighting questions about customer selection and safeguards beyond weaponization.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Faraday Future Completes Robotics Business Transfer to Nasdaq-Listed FFR
item.description: The acquisition closed October 23. FFR forecasts approximately 2,000 robot sales and shipments for the acquired business in 2026 and introduces FF OmniMind.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla’s Optimus Gen 3, Figure 04 and the Next Apollo: When Each Could Be Revealed
item.description: Tesla, Figure and Apptronik are each preparing a new humanoid, and none has given a reveal date. Here is what each company has said, what our reporting adds, and when each robot is most likely to appear.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: GXO Expands Agility Partnership to Two More U.S. Sites, Starting With Digit 4
item.description: Digit deployments in North Carolina and Tennessee are expected in early 2027, with a later transition to Digit 5 when commercially available.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: ROKAE Reports 10,000 Humanoid Arms Delivered, Identifies Schaeffler Factory Deployment
item.description: ROKAE says five Helios wheeled humanoids work on Schaeffler’s Taicang component line, adding supplier detail to the factory’s robot deployment.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Schaeffler COO Sees Humanoid Opportunities in Components, Factories and Services
item.description: In a Gasgoo interview, Jochen Schröder outlines how humanoids could support component sales, factory productivity, customer integration and robot maintenance.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: ETH Zürich Teaches a Humanoid to Climb, Vault and Recover by Planning Body Contacts
item.description: Tested on a Unitree G1, the research combines human motion data and reinforcement learning to connect mobility skills using onboard terrain sensing.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Coordinates 110 Production Humanoids in Guinness-Certified Dance Performance
item.description: AGIBOT’s Expedition A3 fleet performed in Jinan using LinkBots coordination and UWB positioning, while the record category’s eligibility rules remain unclear.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Enact Raises $30M Pre-Seed to Give Factory Robots a Sense of Force
item.description: Founded by 1X and Physical Intelligence alumnus Manuel Yves Galliker, the Zurich startup is developing motors and AI together for small-batch assembly.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Releases Physical Reasoning Dataset to Connect Robot Decisions With Actions
item.description: AGIBOT WORLD Release 4 pairs robot actions with decision-making annotations, covering changing conditions, task memory and multi-step planning.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure 04 Reaches Design Lock as Adcock Details a Multibillion-Dollar AI Push
item.description: Figure’s public all-hands outlines new hardware, 37.5 million human-video uploads and billions in planned compute spending, alongside a Helix 3.0 teaser.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG Shows IRON Switching Between Handshakes, Fist Bumps and High-Fives
item.description: XPENG says IRON updates its visual reasoning every 0.2 seconds to follow changing gestures, in a new demonstration of its VLA 2.0 technology.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NEURA Unveils Lighter 4NE1 Gen 4 as TUM RoboGym Opens in Munich
item.description: The redesigned humanoid arrives alongside a new robot training center, while a separate NXAI partnership targets memory for multi-step tasks.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla Begins Optimus Production in Fremont, Targets Customer Deliveries in Late 2027
item.description: Tesla says its first production-quality Optimus robots are coming off the Fremont line, while Musk outlines the training, hardware and AI work ahead of customer deliveries.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agile Robots Unveils Agile ONE SN as NVIDIA Expands Its Isaac Robotics Platform
item.description: The compact research humanoid combines tactile hands, Jetson Thor and GR00T software, with availability planned for early 2027.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: The Unitree G1 Is Becoming a Platform for American Robot Startups
item.description: Lumi, Voxel and a possible G1 connection beneath Hugo highlight how American startups are building new robot identities around Unitree hardware.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Noetix Robotics Files for Hong Kong IPO, Bloomberg Reports
item.description: The humanoid robot maker could raise several hundred million dollars and list as early as 2027, following a funding round led by a CATL-affiliated investment platform.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Origami Robotics Unveils S1 Glove to Capture Human Dexterity for Robots
item.description: The S1 glove records finger movements, touch and video, with joints matched to Origami’s robot hand. The company says mass production has started.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Flora to Turn Robot Videos Into Training Data
item.description: Flora labels actions and scores robot performance from video. NVIDIA reports 200,000 hours processed daily, with model weights available for research under noncommercial terms.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Humanoid Expands NVIDIA Collaboration, Replacing Two Robot Computers With One
item.description: The UK robot maker says Jetson Thor consolidates two onboard computers into one, as it integrates NVIDIA tools for sensing, AI inference and real-time control.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Generative Bionics Plans Major Humanoid Training Hub in Italy With AMD
item.description: A planned 5,000-square-metre Italian hub would train GENE.01 humanoids using physical tasks and AMD-powered digital twins, with operations targeted for Q4 2027.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree’s H2-X Flips Off Cars in New Kung Fu “Guardian” Video
item.description: Unitree’s new H2-X video combines car-roof flips, martial arts and staged rescue scenes, alongside a claim of approximately eight hours of standing endurance.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Eka Robotics Raises $150 Million to Give Robots a Better Feel for the Physical World
item.description: Eka’s Series A backs a vision-force-action model trained in simulation, with a reported $1.45 billion valuation and a focus on fast, adaptable robot manipulation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Former Boston Dynamics Roboticist Unveils Voxel, a $20,000 Home-Tidying Robot
item.description: Tuesday Labs opens $200 refundable reservations for Voxel, a household robot targeting US deliveries in 2028. Its $20,000 price is an estimate, and the hardware remains in development.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: This Week’s Newsletter: Gemini 4 Meets Apollo, PI Opens Its API and Robots Get to Work
item.description: Catch up on Apollo’s Gemini 4 demonstration, PI’s API beta, Figure’s endurance test and the week’s manufacturing and market news in our free weekly briefing.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: After Its Stock Surge, Unitree Warns Humanoid Commercialization Is Still in Its Early Days
item.description: Unitree flags commercialization and valuation risks after unusual share-price gains, while reporting normal operations and no undisclosed material information.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Schaeffler Puts Humanoids to Work Building Parts for Other Humanoids
item.description: Six humanoids work across five stations at Schaeffler’s new Taicang facility, which combines robot-component production with training, data collection and digital twins.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
